blurb: Infinite Safari Adventures offers custom-designed safari trips across Africa, including culture, history, wildlife, and adventure experiences. Sample itineraries range from 10 to 18 days, covering destinations like Morocco, Southern Africa, Namibia, South Africa, Mozambique, Zambia, Botswana, and Tanzania. Trips include activities such as walking safaris, wildlife viewing, and mountain climbing.
